name: Bhuta Natha Sadananda
meaning: O Lord Shiva, protector of all beings and giver of eternal joy, full of compassion, please protect us.
note: The wording in the client list (“…Shatre Tupyab Namo Namaha”) could not be matched to a source, so its text is held back until Sarvakali confirms it.
supplied:
Bhutanatha Sadananda Sarva Bhuta Daya Para,
Raksha Raksha Mahabhago, Shatre Tupyab Namo Namaha.
